query:
insert into TestCaseOverrides (
                                collect_nr,
                                product_id,
                                test_collect_nr,
                                test_run_name,
                                test_run_date,
                                test_case_name,
                                review_name,
                                review_date,
                                state,
                                comment_hash
                            )
                            select
                                $1,
                                $2,
                                tc.collect_nr,
                                $3,
                                $4,
                                $5,
                                $6,
                                $7,
                                $8,
                                $9
                            from TestCases tc
                            where collect_nr = (
                                select max(ctc.collect_nr)
                                from TestCases ctc
                                where ctc.product_id = tc.product_id
                            )
                            and product_id = $2
                            and test_run_name = $3
                            and test_run_date = $4
                            and name = $5
